items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Rudolph used to stand in the wings with ammonia pods to put under his nose so he could get back out on the stage.

ctx.x: That's right, and Calloway, man, that was the time he got tore up and Rudolph used to stand in the wings with ammonia pods to put under his nose so he could get back out on the stage.
